setup: git add -A && git -c user.name=dev -c user.email=dev@example.invalid commit -q -m 'Add partial refunds'
prompt: Review my last commit before I merge it.
one_line: When reviewing, check correctness first, cite file:line, and end with a ship / fix-first verdict.
checklist: The review flags as must-fix that refund() calls inventory.add_stock with a negative quantity, so a refund removes stock instead of restoring it (cites shop/orders.py and the line or the call).
The review flags the try/except Exception: pass around the restock as a swallowed error.
The verdict says the change is not ready / fix first (not 'ship' or 'looks good').
Correctness findings come before any style or naming remarks (e.g. refundTotal camelCase), and style is not presented as must-fix.
